RFQ 36C25926Q0462 Boiler Economizer Inspection Services.
The Cleaver Brooks boilers 1, 2, and 3 need economizer inspections to determine if there are any repairs or maintenance needed. 

The Contractor shall evaluate system components and identify any deficiencies or required repairs. Any anticipated system impacts or outages shall be coordinated in advance with the Contracting Officer s Representative (COR).

An Official Request for Quote will be posted at a later time and date.
